name: wincc-remaster-scada
description: Clean-room web SCADA platform with WinCC V7.5-style engineering workflows.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:services && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace @scada/domain run build && npm --workspace @scada/db run build && npm --workspace @scada/node-red run build
scripts.build:services: npm --workspace @scada/api run build && npm --workspace @scada/acquisition run build && npm --workspace @scada/publisher run build
scripts.build:apps: npm --workspace @scada/engineering run build && npm --workspace @scada/runtime run build
